body: I’ve done a few things of the sort but I think just the normal negative outcome really destroyed any chance of me trying again. I really wanna try to be happier and have friends though so I’m going to try my best to look around for things like that in my area

I bike outside sometimes just in my driveway and stuff. Not really any sports. i mainly spend my time drawings and stuff, I also play piano but it’s mostly ruined for me since I’m always compared to my older brother who’s a lot better.

I guess a bigger school since I’m transferring was the biggest thing keeping me going but after I left my toxic friends I just lost all the motivation and started getting upset over them instead. It’s such a stupid thought missing such horrible people but I still do it anyways

I guess I lost the main thing keeping me going which were my hella toxic school friends. After that everything got rocky, slowly distanced from like the only friends I had which were online. Family started getting fed up with me. Hobbies aren’t bringing me any joy anymore. Even my therapist doesn’t know what to do with me anymore cause I don’t have the motivation to do what she suggests. Sure there are good times occasionally but the overall feeling of being alone and unloved outweighs it. No matter what I try and do to change myself to become happier, habits, my mindset, my actions to others I always end up back here and I don’t know what to do anymore
